clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, cultists carry Insane Scribbles torn from the Twilight Tome, a fragment of dark literature. The dancing text and distorted scrollwork cause dizziness and mental strain. Ancient forest protectors study the fragments to learn the Twilight's Hammer's motives.

Reading the Twilight Tome can endanger a mortal's sanity. Its script writhes across the parchment, and graceful scrollwork warps into grotesque images before the reader's eyes. Tearing out even one sheet, called Insane Scribbles, leaves the bearer lightheaded and disoriented. Though the writing makes little sense, the parchment hums with primal, deeply ancient magic tied to dark powers long buried beneath Azeroth.
